##### Project general facts

Damac Properties presents Riverside, an exclusive residential townhouse development located in Dubai along the Dubai Water Canal. The project consists of contemporary 4 and 5 bedroom townhouses designed for modern urban living, combining waterfront positioning with strong connectivity to key city areas. The architecture emphasizes a low-rise, community-oriented layout within a master-planned environment, where each residence is designed to maximize views of the canal and surrounding skyline while maintaining privacy and comfort.

Riverside offers a wide range of lifestyle-oriented amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and social interaction. Residents have access to a state-of-the-art fitness center for active living, an infinity swimming pool designed for relaxation with panoramic views, and landscaped lush gardens that create a calm, green environment within the development. In addition, the community includes dedicated spaces for social gatherings, encouraging a balanced lifestyle that combines private residential comfort with shared community experiences.

The interiors of the townhouses feature high-quality finishing with warm-toned wood elements combined with contemporary tiling, creating a modern yet inviting aesthetic. Kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, ensuring functionality and convenience for everyday living. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents flexibility in furnishing their homes according to personal style, while maintaining a consistent standard of premium, contemporary interior finishing throughout the development.

##### Location description and benefits

Riverside is nestled along the serene banks of the Dubai Water Canal, offering residents a picturesque setting with tranquil water views and lush greenery. Located in Dubai, one of the most dynamic and cosmopolitan cities in the world, Riverside enjoys a prime location within easy reach of the city's key attractions and amenities.

The area surrounding Riverside is characterized by modern infrastructure, vibrant cultural hubs, and a thriving business district. Residents can explore nearby dining and entertainment options, indulge in retail therapy at upscale malls, or unwind in beautifully landscaped parks and promenades.

Riverside boasts a seamless blend of urban sophistication and natural beauty, providing an ideal sanctuary for those seeking a harmonious balance between city living and tranquil surroundings. With its strategic location and abundance of leisure facilities, Riverside offers residents an unparalleled lifestyle experience in the heart of Dubai.
